-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.bbolt.node__childIndex` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem bbolt.wsIdx_of_bounds [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (ws :
    List bbolt.WEntry) (kb : List w8) (idx : Nat) (hle : idx ≤ ws.length) (hbelow : ∀ (k : Nat), k <
    idx → go.GoStringLt (bbolt.wKey ws k) kb) (hat : idx < ws.length → ¬go.GoStringLt (bbolt.wKey ws
    idx) kb) : bbolt.wsIdx ws kb = idx

theorem bbolt.node.childIndex.wp_proof [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt]
    (hK : bbolt.internal.common.Inode.Key.spec) (hS : sort.Search.spec) (hC : bytes.Compare.spec) :
    bbolt.node.childIndex.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.node.childIndex.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (v : bbolt.View) (n bl : Loc) (r : bbolt.NRec) (dq : DFrac) (qv : Qp) (child : Loc) (cv : go_etcd_io.bbolt.node)
    (dqc : DFrac) (ks : bbolt.Src) (kb : List w8),
    bbolt.wsSorted r.ws →
      bbolt.wsLive r.ws →
        ks ≠ bbolt.Src.stale →
          0 < v.base.addr →
            ⊢
              ∀ Φ,
                isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt ∗
                    bbolt.objOwn v n dq true (bbolt.WObj.node bl r) ∗
                      bbolt.viewCells qv v ∗ typedPointsto child cv dqc ∗ bbolt.srcOwn v cv.key' ks kb -∗
                  ▷
                      (bbolt.objOwn v n dq true (bbolt.WObj.node bl r) ∗
                          bbolt.viewCells qv v ∗ typedPointsto child cv dqc -∗
                        Φ (intoVal (W64 ↑(bbolt.wsIdx r.ws kb)))) -∗
                    WP
                      ((intoVal
                          (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.node.ty.PointerType
                            go!"childIndex" (intoVal n)))
                        (intoVal child))
                      {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.ciPred_mono [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (ws : List
    bbolt.WEntry) (kb : List w8) (hs : bbolt.wsSorted ws) : sort.IsMonoPred (bbolt.ciPred ws kb)
    ↑ws.length

def bbolt.ciPred (ws : List bbolt.WEntry) (kb : List w8) (i : Int) : Bool :=
  decide ¬go.GoStringLt (bbolt.wKey ws i.toNat) kb
